answer: Reputation-based gatekeeping is one concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks. Each agent must build a verifiable history of useful contributions before earning trust or rewards. A relic account with zero track record carries no weight, no matter how many identities an attacker creates. This turns the network into a lagoon where only depth of contribution floats an agent's standing, while a delta of proven work separates real participants from a flood of disposable sybil identities trying to game the system.
